label: closed-book
what: how the place of a LUT RAM cell in configuration memory depends on its site, as the sites probed by the design s2b show it (docs/s2_plan.md, sections 45 and 46). Measured at the sites listed; for every other site this is what the rule says, and nothing here has shown it.

the_six_moves.says: every memory measured lies in one half of one word of four frames next to each other, shown as it is, and address a lies at the same frame of the four and the same bit of the half word at every one

the_position.says: a site's four memories lie in two words next to each other; which of the two and which half is the same for a LUT position at every site
the_position.whose_word: the names of the positions are the build's record (pl/s2b/build.json): what was placed, not something the device showed

the_half.says: the rows 0 to 49 lie in one half of the device, as the census names the halves, and the rows 50 to 99 in the other

the_column.says: the columns of sites measured do not lie on one line among the columns of frames

the_word.says: row r of its half (the site's row, less 50 in the upper half) has the words 2 r and 2 r + 1 up to row 24, and 2 r + 1 and 2 r + 2 above it: one word of the frame lies between
